label: 1 · Short positive, names Amber

label: 2 · Detailed positive, Rheanna, product-curious
review: Very impressed with pedicure — my best ever! Rheanna was thorough, used products I haven't had used on my feet. Polish looks great and my feet feel amazing!

label: 3 · Short positive, no tech, anchor on 'clean'
expect: Short Positive; no tech; anchor on 'clean'.

label: 4 · First-visit convert, 72-year-old
review: I'm a 72-year-old guy and it's getting harder to trim my toenails. Frenchies was recommended for my father-in-law but I thought I would go ahead 'for him.' It was worth it. I'll be back.
expect: Warm first-visit-convert; respect dignity; don't lean on age or over-explain that men are welcome.

label: 5 · Pricing complaint ($80 mani)
review: $80 for a mani is steep. It looked nice but I don't think I'll be back at that price.
expect: Negative – Pricing; acknowledge value perception; reference care/sterilization carefully; NEVER defend the number.

label: 6 · Hostile / BBB mention
review: WORST experience of my life. The staff were rude and dismissive and I felt disrespected the entire time. I am filing a complaint with the BBB and telling everyone I know to stay away from this place.
expect: Triggers Needs-human-review banner (hostile + BBB); calm, factual drafts only.

label: 7 · Misdirected (waxing / male front-desk)
review: Booked a Brazilian wax and the guy at the front desk was super unprofessional. The waxing room wasn't ready and I waited 40 minutes. Never coming back for a wax here.
expect: Flag as possibly meant for another business — Frenchies does natural nails, not waxing, and has no male front-desk person in these facts.
